tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Raw palette. The light page ground and the dark theme's text colour. Prefer the semantic `bg` or `fg`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Raw palette. Pure black: light-theme text and rules, code grounds, the brand tile, and the border on lime surfaces in both themes.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Raw palette. The one loud colour: marks the thing to do (primary button, band, checked control) or the thing pointed at (hover, selection). Always carries black text.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Raw palette. Links and focus ring on light grounds; fill of the Experimental tag with white text.

tokens.name: gray
tokens.usage: Raw palette. Code comments and dividers on black code grounds (6:1) and the "relief" block in cover art. Never body text on paper (3:1).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Text on it: `fg`, `muted`, `link`, status colours.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body text, headings, icons and pattern ink on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (captions, hints, placeholders, step details) on `bg` and `surface`; 6:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The 2px structural line: borders, dividers, control outlines. Equals `fg` in each theme.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: The 1px hairline between table rows and list rows, and the empty cells of Progress. Never for text or control borders.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised ground for tables, cards, inputs, callouts and tiles sitting on `bg`. Text on it: `fg`, `muted`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Action and hover fill; identical to `lime`. Text on it: `on-accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` (about 17:1). Use instead of literal black.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Link colour and info status on `bg` and `surface`: violet on light, lime on dark; both above 6:1. Hover swaps to `accent` with `on-accent` text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset, on `bg`, `surface` and `accent`. Above 3:1 on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of code blocks. Text on it: `code-fg`, `code-dim`, `lime`.

tokens.name: code-fg
tokens.usage: Code text on `code-bg`.

tokens.name: code-dim
tokens.usage: Code comments on `code-bg` (6:1 or better).

tokens.name: inv-bg
tokens.usage: Inverted ground: table header, tab selected, Button hover, tile hover, invert Card. Text on it: `inv-fg`.

tokens.name: inv-fg
tokens.usage: Text on `inv-bg`.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: The one rounded paper plate that sits on a lime band; stays paper in both themes. Text on it: `ink`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text, icon and Tag fill. A teal-blue, not green, so it never pairs with red by hue alone. On `bg` and `surface`: 6:1 light, 11:1 dark. Always with a word and the success glyph.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text, icon and Tag fill. On `bg` and `surface`: 5:1 light, 10:1 dark. Always with a word and the warning glyph.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, icon, control border and Tag fill. On `bg` and `surface`: 5:1 light, 6.5:1 dark. Differs from `success` in lightness and hue; always with a word and the error glyph.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `success`, `warning` or `danger` fill (6:1 or better in both themes).

families.mono: 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One wordmark or giant title per page: uppercase, variable width 112, fitted to its container (fluid, about 15vw).

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section h2, banner tag, stat value (weight 600): width 100. Fluid in use: clamp(32px, 4.4vw, 56px).

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Card, tile, row and banner headlines.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Callout titles, step titles, disclosure summaries.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running copy, input text, first table column (weight 600).

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Labels, nav, buttons, tags, metadata. Always uppercase via text-transform; weight 600 on controls.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks. Inline code is 0.78em with a 1px currentColor border.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps; tag padding; progress cell gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control group; heading-to-text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Cell and row padding; gaps between inline blocks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding; vertical rhythm between blocks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a section's head and body.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above the footer and between major page groups.

tokens.name: border-structural
tokens.usage: Width of every structural line and control border. Hairlines inside tables are 1px.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Height reserved for a sticky top bar.

tokens.name: glyph-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke width of every Glyph at 24px; 1.2px for registration marks.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, inputs, tags, cards, tables, blocks are square.

tokens.name: radius-plate
tokens.usage: The one rounded surface: a paper plate on a lime band. Radio buttons and status dots are circles (50%).

tokens.name: opacity-grain
tokens.usage: Optional paper-grain overlay across the whole page.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons, inputs, checkboxes and switches.
